concerns.location: spec.md:FR-001, FR-002, SC-001 vs plan.md Summary 'Scope inconsistency'
concerns.text: FR-001/FR-002/SC-001 require downloading diffusion tractography and constructing structural connectomes for ≥95% of 50 subjects. The plan gates the entire structural half ('if no real structural connectomes are downloadable... skips motif–rsFC association testing'), so FR-001, FR-002, and SC-001 have NO satisfiable plan element. The plan correctly surfaces this, but the root cause is the spec's Data Access section naming unverified ds001734. Spec must be corrected (name a verified open diffusion source or reframe the question) before the plan can cover these FRs.

The spec's Assumptions section commits to a motif-z sensitivity analysis sweeping |z| ∈ {1.5, 2.0, 2.5} and reporting how the number of significant motifs varies. No plan task, contract field, or report section covers this. Either add a plan element (e.g., extend T007/T008) or remove it from the spec.

US-3 acceptance 2 requires the permutation empirical p to be 'consistent with the analytical correction within 2× the standard error of the mean for the permutation distribution'. T007 computes empirical p but no plan element defines or checks this consistency criterion. Add a validation step or drop the acceptance clause at spec level.

These two contract files are not referenced by any task (T011 validates only manifest, motif profiles, correlation results, metadata) and duplicate/contradict output.schema.yaml (e.g., 'VIF for the control variable', method_used enum with ridge_regression, motif_triangle_z etc.). Plan elements with no backing FR — drop them or reconcile with output.schema.yaml.
